# Generated API clients

Everything under this folder is generated by `ng-openapi-gen` from the services' OpenAPI documents
(for example `src/Services/Requests/ProcureAi.Requests.Api/openapi/requests-v1.json`).
**Do not edit by hand.** Change the API, build it (`dotnet build` rewrites the OpenAPI document), then run
`npm run generate:api` in `src/Web/procure-ai-web` and commit the result. CI fails when the folder differs
from what the generator produces.
